title: Congruent Partitions of Polygons
exact_target: Find an optimal congruent partition of a given polygon $P$ into $n$ pieces. Decide whether a perfect congruent partition exists (especially for $n>2$); determine how the problem changes when reflections are prohibited; and bound the least uncovered area in terms of $P$ and $n$.
